title_block.title: PMI Fully-Toleranced Test Case 6
title_block.sheet_note: PMI Fully-Toleranced Test Case 6 - View A. Includes Atomic Test Cases - 52, 53, 72, 87, 88, 89; PMI Fully-Toleranced Test Case 6 - View B. Includes Atomic Test Cases - 57, 58; PMI Fully-Toleranced Test Case 6 - View C. Includes Atomic Test Cases - 73, 80
title_block.standard: ASME Y14.5M-1994 (dimensioning and tolerancing); ASME Y14.41-2003 (dataset)

features.label: whole part
features.description: The whole machined block shown on all three sheets. Used for general notes that apply to the part as a whole.

features.label: spherical dimple in the top of the left block
features.description: Shallow round spherical recess in the top face of the raised block at the back left of View A.

features.label: 2X rounded corners of the uprights
features.description: The rounded top corners of the two upright lugs that carry the cross holes; the leader points to the back lug in View A.

features.label: 24X small fillets
features.description: Small rounded inside corners where walls meet floors around the part; the leader points to the one at the foot of the back lug in View A.

features.label: 2X ball studs
features.description: Two spherical balls standing on short posts on the top face of the base.

features.label: top face of the base
features.description: The large flat top face of the base plate, on which the balls, cones and bosses stand. It is datum feature D.

features.label: 2X counterbored cross holes in the uprights
features.description: Round holes running sideways through the two upright lugs, each with a counterbore; the leader points to the one in the front lug in View A.

features.label: 4X counterbored holes in the base
features.description: Four counterbored mounting holes in the top face of the base; the leader points to the one at the front left in View A.

features.label: bottom face of the base
features.description: The flat underside of the base plate; the leader lands on its front edge. It is datum feature A.

features.label: 4X horizontal cylindrical bosses
features.description: Four short cylinders lying on their sides along the front edge of the base in View A. Each one's outer surface is its own datum feature F.

features.label: 4X counterbored holes in the bosses
features.description: Small holes along the axis of each horizontal boss, with a counterbore at the boss end face.

features.label: sloped face of the wedge
features.description: The inclined top face of the wedge-shaped block in the middle of the part, dimensioned by a slope of 1 in 2.

features.label: 2X tapered cones
features.description: Two cone-shaped posts on the top face of the base, each with a small hole in its flat top.

features.label: end face of the block beside the bosses
features.description: The flat vertical face of the block at the back of View B, next to the row of horizontal bosses and facing the same way as their end faces, so the boss axes are square to it. It is datum feature E.

features.label: length of the base (end faces)
features.description: The 12.00 in overall length of the base, measured between its two end faces; this width is datum feature B.

features.label: long side face of the part
features.description: The long flat side face at the front right of View B, running the full 12.00 in length; both upright cross holes break through it. It is datum feature C.

features.label: left V-groove and slot
features.description: V-shaped groove at the top left of View C, ending in a narrow straight slot at its bottom. Datum targets J1 and J2 sit on its two sloping faces.

features.label: right V-groove and slot
features.description: V-shaped groove at the top right of View C, ending in a narrow straight slot at its bottom. Datum targets K1 and K2 sit on its two sloping faces.

features.label: cone at lower left of View C
features.description: The cone at the lower left of View C. A circular target line G1 around it defines datum G, and a small blind hole is drilled in its top.

features.label: cone at lower right of View C
features.description: The cone at the lower right of View C. A circular target line H1 around it defines datum H, and a small blind hole is drilled in its top.

values.raw: 1. CAD MODEL ___________ REV. __ IS REQUIRED TO COMPLETE PRODUCT DEFINITION.
values.meaning: General note 1: the drawing is incomplete on its own; the CAD model (name and revision left blank) is needed to define the part.

values.raw: 2. DIRECTLY-TOLERANCED DIMENSIONS AND BASIC DIMENSIONS DEFINED ON THE DRAWING TAKE PRECEDENCE OVER DIMENSIONAL DATA DEFINED BY THE MODEL. OBTAIN ALL OTHER DIMENSIONAL DATA FROM THE MODEL. THE MODEL REPRESENTS BASIC DIMENSIONAL DATA UNLESS OTHERWISE SPECIFIED.
values.meaning: General note 2: numbers on the drawing win over the model; every other size comes from the model and counts as a basic (exact) value.

values.raw: 3. APPLICABLE STANDARDS: ASME Y14.41-2003 APPLIES TO DATASET. ASME Y14.5M-1994 APPLIES TO DIMENSIONING AND TOLERANCING.
values.meaning: General note 3: the model follows ASME Y14.41-2003 and the dimensions and tolerances follow ASME Y14.5M-1994.

values.applies_to: all untoleranced surfaces (general note 4: APPLIES TO ALL UNTOLERANCED SURFACES)
values.meaning: General note 4: every surface that has no other tolerance must lie within a 0.05 in profile band around its true shape, located from datums A, B and C.
General note 5: all dimensions on the drawing are in inches.
Reference dimension: the dimple is a spherical recess of about 0.500 in radius; for information only.
Controlled radius at two places: each corner must be a smooth arc of 0.50 in radius, plus or minus 0.02 in, with no flats or reversals.
At 24 places, the fillet radius must be 0.125 in, plus or minus 0.020 in, so between 0.105 and 0.145 in.
Each of the two balls must be 1.250 in in spherical diameter, plus or minus 0.008 in.
Position: each ball's centre must lie inside a 0.025 in diameter sphere at its true location, measured from datums D, B and C.
Profile of a surface: the base top face must lie within a 0.02 in band around its true position and shape, located from datums A, B and C.
Flatness: the base top face must also lie between two parallel planes 0.01 in apart.
Datum feature D: the base top face is a reference plane for the controls that name D.
Each of the two cross holes must be 0.562 in across, plus or minus 0.008 in.
Position: each cross hole's axis must lie inside a 0.015 in diameter cylinder at its true location, measured from datums C, A and B.

values.applies_to: counterbore
values.meaning: Each cross hole's counterbore must be 0.812 in across, plus or minus 0.020 in.

values.applies_to: counterbore depth
values.meaning: Each counterbore must be 0.56 in deep, plus or minus 0.02 in.

values.applies_to: counterbore
values.meaning: Position: each counterbore's axis must lie inside a 0.025 in diameter cylinder at its true location when the counterbore is at its smallest size (MMC), measured from datums C, A and B.
Each of the four base holes must be 0.415 in across, plus or minus 0.008 in.

values.applies_to: counterbore
values.meaning: Each base hole's counterbore must be 0.625 in across, plus or minus 0.020 in.

values.applies_to: counterbore depth
values.meaning: Each base-hole counterbore must be 0.50 in deep, plus or minus 0.02 in.
Position: each counterbored base hole's axis must lie inside a 0.025 in diameter cylinder at its true location when the hole is at its smallest size (MMC), measured from datums A, B and C.
Flatness: the bottom face of the base must lie between two parallel planes 0.01 in apart.
Datum feature A: the bottom face of the base is the primary reference plane.
Each of the four boss holes must be 0.281 in across, plus or minus 0.008 in.
Position: each boss hole's axis must lie inside a 0.015 in diameter cylinder at its true location, measured from datums E, A and B.
Datum feature F, applied to each boss on its own: the outer cylinder of each boss is the reference for that boss's counterbore.
Text beside datum F: the datum symbol applies to each of the four bosses separately.

values.applies_to: counterbore
values.meaning: Each boss's counterbore must be 0.40 in across, plus or minus 0.01 in.

values.applies_to: counterbore depth
values.meaning: Each boss counterbore must be 0.31 in deep, plus or minus 0.02 in.

values.applies_to: counterbore
values.meaning: Position: each counterbore's axis must lie inside a 0.02 in diameter cylinder (at MMC) centred on its own boss's axis, datum F.
Text under the frame: the counterbore callout and its position apply to each of the four bosses separately.
Box naming the separate PDF that indexes the features and specifications of this part.
Series header: the sheet belongs to the 2014 NIST PMI test model set.

Drawing number (file identifier) printed along the right border.
Profile of a surface: the wedge's sloped face must lie within a 0.04 in band around its true shape, located from datums A, B and C.

values.applies_to: slope of the face
values.meaning: Slope: the face drops 1.00 for every 2.00 along its length (a ratio, not a length); its tolerance comes from the profile control.

values.applies_to: taper of each cone
values.meaning: Conical taper at two places: each cone's diameter changes by 1.00 for every 3.00 along its axis (a ratio, not a length).

values.applies_to: cone at front left of View B; upper segment of a composite frame
values.meaning: Composite profile, upper segment: the cone's surface must lie within a 0.05 in band at its true location from datums D, B and C.

values.applies_to: cone at front left of View B; lower segment of a composite frame
values.meaning: Composite profile, lower segment: the cone's shape and its orientation to datum D must hold within a tighter 0.01 in band.
Profile of a surface: the end face of the block beside the bosses must lie within a 0.02 in band around its true position, located from datums A, B and C.
Flatness: the end face of the block beside the bosses must lie between two parallel planes 0.01 in apart.
Datum feature E: the end face of the block beside the bosses is a reference plane.

values.applies_to: cone at the back of View B; upper segment of a composite frame
values.meaning: Composite profile, upper segment: the cone's surface must lie within a 0.05 in band at its true location from datums D, B and C.

values.applies_to: cone at the back of View B; lower segment of a composite frame
values.meaning: Composite profile, lower segment: the cone's shape and its orientation to datum D must hold within a tighter 0.01 in band.
Perpendicularity: the long side face must lie between two parallel planes 0.012 in apart that are square to datum A and oriented to datum B.
Datum feature C: the long side face of the part is a reference plane.
The base must be 12.00 in long between its end faces, plus or minus 0.01 in.
Perpendicularity: the centre plane of the 12.00 in length must lie between two parallel planes 0.012 in apart, square to datum A.
Datum feature B: the centre plane of the 12.00 in length is a reference.

values.applies_to: width of the slot at the bottom of the V

values.applies_to: width of the slot at the bottom of the V

values.applies_to: target line on a sloping face of the V
